title: Junior Sales Administrator
description:
Junior Sales Administrator
Leicester LE4
Days Shifts
£25k per annum, Holiday, Pension

Are you an Experienced Sales Administrator within the manufacturing industry? If yes, read on .

My client is one of the world's leading manufacturers within their industry, a privately owned business. They are currently looking for a skilled Junior Sales Administrator to support their sales team.

The Role - Junior Sales Administrator:
- Handle incoming calls from customers and enquiries via telephone and email in a professional manner.
- Manage all enquiries and quotations in the company s systems to ensure all sales data is logged accurately.
- Prepare, process and issue quotations accurately and promptly, ensuring customers are informed of timelines or any potential delays.
- Use initiative to contact customers to follow up orders, quotes and outstanding purchase orders.
- Provide general administrative support within the branch as and when required.
- Support the Internal Sales Manager in generating and following up on quotes, purchase orders and customer communications.
- Ability to prioritise administrative tasks and duties related to sales to ensure timely completion.
- Take on any other responsibilities delegated to you by the company to support the business needs and objectives.
- Create and manage job records, making sure all documentation and purchase orders are correctly processed.

Minimum Skills / Experience Required - Junior Sales Administrator
- Experience in an administrative role or sales support role (ideally within a commercial or business development environment).
- Strong customer service skills with a professional and confident telephone manner.
- Strong attention to detail and highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Able to work well as part of a team as well as independently.
- Calm and efficient when working under pressure.
- Able to commute to the LE4 area

The Package - Junior Sales Administrator:
- £12.71 per hour
- Free onsite parking
- Pension

title: Office Administrator
description:
Office Administrator

Leicester based

Salary: Up to £27,000

Permanent, Full-Time

Are you an experienced Office Administrator?

Regional Recruitment are recruiting for an Administrator to join an established business based in Leicester. You will play a key role in supporting the sales team with the day-to-day administration, helping to manage customer enquiries, orders and paperwork and ensuring everything runs smoothly.

What's on Offer:
- Salary up to £27,000 per year
- Monday to Friday working hours
- Varied sales administration and customer support role
- Opportunity to join an established business

Qualifications

Essential:
- Previous experience in an office administration, sales administration, customer service or coordination role
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a busy environment
- Good attention to detail
- Confident using Microsoft Office and other administrative systems

Desirable:
- Previous experience supporting a sales team
- Experience processing customer orders or sales enquiries
- Experience using CRM or sales order systems
- Previous experience within a commercial or customer-focused environment

Roles & Responsibilities
- Manage the day-to-day administration and provide support to the sales team.
- Process customer orders and ensure information is entered accurately onto internal systems.
- Deal with customer enquiries and provide updates where required.
- Prepare quotes, sales paperwork and other relevant documentation.
- Liaise with customers and internal departments to ensure orders are processed efficiently.
- Keep customer records and sales information up to date.
- Monitor outstanding enquiries and orders, following up where necessary.
- Assist the sales team with general administration and customer support.
- Provide general administrative support across the wider business when required.

Requirements

As Office Administrator, you will also be expected to:
- Be a proactive, organised individual who can manage multiple priorities in a busy environment.
- Have excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Have strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Be confident dealing with customers and colleagues.
- Be confident working independently and as part of a wider team.
